# `unnecessaryArrowBlock`

Suggests using a concise arrow body when the block only returns an expression

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377084` |
| Language Service name | `unnecessaryArrowBlock` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/unnecessary-arrow-block` |

## Preview

```ts
export const preview = (value: string) => {
/**
                                          ^ effecttsgo(unnecessary-arrow-block): This arrow function block only returns an expression and can use a concise body.
*/
	return value.trim()
/**
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
*/
}
/**
^
*/
```

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{

    "plugins": [

        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "unnecessaryArrowBlock": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
